rationale: The title and abstract indicate an overview of health care delivery and entitlement through the Indian Health Service for American Indians, with no mention of household or community water or sanitation services or WASH access outcomes (excluded as wrong topic, E01).
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both the narrow rule-type reading and the plain wording of Criterion 2 result in exclusion because the article concerns health care entitlement through the Indian Health Service rather than household or community water or sanitation service access (Criterion 1 and Criterion 4 fail under both readings).

evidence_quotes.quote: Health Care: An Overview of the Indian Health Service
At first glance, the Indian Health Service (IHS) seems to be an ideal entitlement program promoting the health of all American Indians.
